heading: Three-Way Catalytic Converter (Twc} System
text:
EMISSION CONTROL - THREE-WAY CATALYTIC CONVERTER (TWC) EC-11
SYSTEM
\ i THREE-WAY CATALYTIC CONVERTER (TWC} SYSTEM
INSPECTION
1. CHECK TWC FOR DENTS OR DAMAGE
If any port of the heat insulator is damaged or dented to the extent that it contacts the three-way catalytic
converter, repair or replace it.
2. CHECK EXHAUST PIPE CONNECTIONS FOR LOOSENESS OR DAMAGE
3. CHECK EXHAUST PIPE CLAMPS FOR WEAKNESS, CRACKS OR DAMAGE
4. CHECK HEAT INSULATOR FOR DAMAGE
5. CHECK FOR ADEQUATE CLEARANCE BETWEEN EXHAUST SYSTEM AND HEAT INSULATOR
ON THE BODY
